Iron Gatekeeper (CV 44)

A massive iron guardian with a barred face, oversized hands and its charter engraved across the chest. Built for a particular threshold, it is difficult to displace and slow to redirect.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility -1; Guile -2; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 34 · Speed: 4 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 3

Evasion: 1 Boon · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 2

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (3)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep; Frightened

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Gate bar

A great limb scythes across the ground, forcing everyone nearby to move.

Target: Up to two creatures within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Push each 2. Standard defense: Push each 1.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Lifeless Body: does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

Healing: Construct: ordinary HP healing does not repair it; destroyed at 0. Combat repair requires an explicit repair ability. Workshop repair remains a design question.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: The gate’s counterweight has not moved, yet the gate opens each dawn.

Purpose: Admit only those named by its charter.

Tactics and retreat: Sweep two intruders away from the threshold and remain beside the gate.

Counterplay and conversation: Produce valid authority or use an entrance outside its charter.

Habitat: Fortress; city gate · Communication: None

Loot: A command seal and 50 coins of salvage from a real body; no extra suit of wearable heavy armor.

Summoning: Construct 7 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.e9bb46f65d32c0cd.JournalEntryPage.2834157afef68850]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

Category: Construct · Role: Heavy guardian · CV: 44

Difficulty rationale: A slow or broad exposed body gives the attacker a Boon. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference type: physical

Utility factor: 1.2
